arms.text:
Root cause: clusterrole `configmap-cleanup-controller`.
Mechanism: ConfigMap reservation-cleanup-token has been terminating for 128s, held by finalizer cleanup.reservations.io/pending-cleanup; linked to this component because its ClusterRole configmap-cleanup-controller covers configmaps and its logs show authorization denials; removing a finalizer requires patch or update on configmaps, which ClusterRole configmap-cleanup-controller does not grant (it grants get, list, watch).

Observed impact: deployment `cleanup-controller` in namespace `hotel-reservation`.
Fault type: rbac permission (the component is denied Kubernetes API operations it needs).
Evidence:
